description: Generate a fix prompt from saved domain observations. Prepare a coding-agent prompt from an owned report within the free allowance or active plan. Read prompt_allowance first. A check uses one unit; full uses three. Preserve request_id for retries.

check_id.description: registration, certificate, dns or email. Required for check; absent for full.

id.description: Owned tab in the active organization ID.

language.description: Language of the prompt instructions and check names: en for English, pt for Portuguese.

request_id.description: New UUID v4 per generation. Keep it unchanged for retries.

source.description: domain: the saved registration, certificate, DNS and email observations of the tab.
